contentBlocks.title: SASSA Mpumalanga Province
contentBlocks.description: Provincial hub for Mpumalanga beneficiaries: regional office contacts, full-service office towns, rural mobile services, and answers to common questions.

contentBlocks.collectionInfo: Mpumalanga beneficiaries receive payments at retail cash points, via bank EFTs, and at post office hubs. Mobile pay points service deep rural communities in Bushbuckridge and around Emalahleni, complementing the province's mix of urban centres and rural areas.

contentBlocks.text: Full-service SASSA offices operate in the major towns — Mbombela, eMalahleni (Witbank), Secunda, Middelburg and Ermelo — handling applications, reviews, card replacements and appeals support. Smaller towns are served by satellite points and scheduled mobile units, with Bushbuckridge residents relying on a combination of mobile visits and the nearest full-service offices in Mbombela or Hazyview.

Collection is straightforward in urban centres: every national retailer chain processes SASSA card withdrawals free of charge on payment days. Bank transfers suit beneficiaries with accounts and reflect within days of each official date.

In Bushbuckridge and other deep rural zones, monthly mobile pay points bring cash collection closer to home. Confirm visit dates each month through your local office or community structures before travelling, since schedules adjust for road conditions.

items: Retail collection works at Boxer, Pick n Pay, Shoprite, Checkers and Usave province-wide.
Switch payment methods any time: SRD via the online portal, other grants at an office.
Bushbuckridge is served by mobile units plus Hazyview/Mbombela offices.
Mid-month office visits avoid the pay-week queues common in eMalahleni and Secunda.

faqs.question: Can I collect my grant at any retailer in Mpumalanga?
faqs.answer: Yes. Boxer, Pick n Pay, Shoprite, Checkers and Usave process SASSA cash payouts across all Mpumalanga towns.

faqs.question: How do Bushbuckridge residents access SASSA services?
faqs.answer: Through scheduled mobile units and local retail pay points; the nearest full-service offices are in Mbombela or Hazyview. Check monthly mobile schedules for visit dates.

faqs.question: Is there a SASSA office in every town?
faqs.answer: No. Full-service offices sit in Mbombela, eMalahleni, Secunda, Middelburg and Ermelo; smaller towns rely on mobile units and satellite points.

faqs.question: Can I switch from Cash Send to bank transfer?
faqs.answer: Yes. SRD beneficiaries change methods on the online portal; other grant types change at any SASSA office with your ID.
